title: Embedding Democratic Values into Social Media AIs via Societal Objective Functions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring partisan animosity and affective polarization using a 'feeling thermometer' survey after exposing participants (U.S. Democrats and Republicans) to simulated social media feeds with various ranking algorithms. The study also evaluates individual social media posts for partisan animosity and anti-democratic attitudes using both expert manual annotations and zero-shot prompting with a Large Language Model (GPT-4).
